turns.text: Hello, come in. How have you been since last time?
I am not sure where to begin, there are so many things going round in my head at the moment.
What went through your mind then?
On Wednesday I slept in the bed for the first time since June.
And how was that for you?
Some days are better than others, and I try to remind myself of that when things get heavy. It is not easy to talk about.
How did that feel for you?
Biscuit could hardly get up the stairs, and I carried him to bed.
I see. Can you say a bit more?
The journey here took a while, but at least I had time to gather my thoughts. I do not know, it is hard to explain.
And how was that for you?
It is strange to sit here and say all of this out loud, but it does help a little.
And how was that for you?
Joy flew home on Monday and the house felt even emptier for a day.
How did that feel for you?
The train was late again this morning, so I almost did not make it on time today. I do not know, it is hard to explain.
Mm-hm. Go on.
I made myself a cup of tea this morning and just stood by the window for a while.
How did that feel for you?
I did my first Tuesday shift at the food bank, sorting tins and tea bags.
And how was that for you?
I had a long day yesterday and I was so tired in the evening that I just sat in front of the television. It is not easy to talk about.
We are nearly out of time. Is there anything you want to add?
Thank you, see you next week.
